headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for Mitsubishi heat pumps using Kumo Cloud v3 API.
footerDisplay: For help and support, visit the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/burtherman/homebridge-mitsubishi-comfort).

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: Polling interval when streaming is healthy (minimum 5 seconds, default 30)

disablePolling.title: Disable Polling
disablePolling.description: Disable polling when streaming is healthy (will auto-enable if streaming fails)

debug.title: Debug Mode
debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging (requires running Homebridge with -D flag)

excludeDevices.title: Hide Device IDs

items.title: Device Serial Number
items.description: Enter device serial number to hide

excludeDevices.description: Device serial numbers to hide from HomeKit (found in logs during device discovery)

streamingHealthCheckInterval.title: Streaming Health Check Interval (seconds)
streamingHealthCheckInterval.description: How often to check if streaming is healthy (default: 30 seconds)

streamingStaleThreshold.title: Streaming Stale Threshold (seconds)
streamingStaleThreshold.description: Consider streaming stale if no updates received for this long (default: 60 seconds)

degradedPollInterval.title: Degraded Mode Poll Interval (seconds)
degradedPollInterval.description: Fast polling interval when streaming is unhealthy (default: 10 seconds)

localControl.title: Enable Local Control (experimental)
localControl.description: Control units directly over the LAN for lower latency and cloud-outage resilience, with the cloud as a per-unit fallback. Needs each unit's local credentials, which Mitsubishi no longer issues for accounts or units registered after the switch to the Comfort app; see the README. Your Homebridge host must share a network with the units.

localPollInterval.title: Local Poll Interval (seconds)
localPollInterval.description: How often to read unit status over the LAN when local control is enabled (default: 15)

localControlIps.title: Local IP Overrides
localControlIps.description: Optional manual { "<deviceSerial>": "<ip>" } map to skip LAN discovery for specific units (edit via the JSON config editor).

mirror.title: Device Mirroring
mirror.description: Make one unit follow another. Whenever the source changes (via any control — wall thermostat, Kumo app, or HomeKit), its full state (mode, setpoints, on/off, fan, and vane on targets that have one) is copied to the target. One-way; a manual change to the target holds until the source changes again.

source.title: Source Device Serial
source.description: The unit to copy from (found in logs during device discovery)

target.title: Target Device Serial
target.description: The unit that follows the source

showDrySwitch.title: Show Dry switches
showDrySwitch.description: Show a "Dry" (dehumidify) switch on units that support it. The switch is on only while the unit is actually drying.

showFanOnlySwitch.title: Show Fan Only switches
showFanOnlySwitch.description: Show a "Fan Only" switch on units that support fan-only mode (no heating or cooling). Fan speed is a separate control on the unit's tile.

showHumiditySensor.title: Show humidity sensors
showHumiditySensor.description: Show indoor humidity as a humidity sensor on units that report it. Turn off if it crowds the unit's tile in the Home app.

exposeVaneSlat.title: Show vane tilt controls
exposeVaneSlat.description: Show a vane control with five fixed positions on units with movable vanes. Off by default: the Home app groups it with window coverings, so a "close the blinds" command can reach it. Swing on/off is on the unit's tile either way.
